translation: Kuba uthe ukwehla namhlanje, wabhengula izinkomo ezinamafutha nezimvu ngeenkomshi, wabizela onke oonyana benkosi, noorhulumente wemikhosi, noyiTsadok... uyazibulala into yokuthi: wabizela u-Evyathar umngcwabele inkosi — ewe, bati besitya besebela phambi kwakhe, bathi: “Phila adoniyahu!”
